page.title: Do Not Stop Codes – Free Credits in Roblox
page.meta_description: Every code listed for Do Not Stop on Roblox, how to redeem them in the lobby (GARAGE > CODES), and what each one gives you.
page.tagline: Six codes, 1,350 credits, and one rule you really shouldn't break.
overview: Do Not Stop is a Roblox experience built on a single threat: keep driving. The game's own description puts it plainly — "DO. NOT. STOP. DRIVING. at any cost, or it will catch you." It's inspired by analog horror creatures and stories, and servers hold up to 20 players at a time.

The game has a code system, and the codes are published right in the description on the Roblox page. You enter them in the lobby under GARAGE > CODES, and each one pays out credits — between 150 and 250 per code. Gameplay videos show runs split between driver and passenger roles across multiple levels, ending in a full playthrough finale, so there's more to a session than just holding the accelerator.
This page collects the codes that are currently listed, explains exactly where to type them, and covers the basics of what the game is before you load in.

how_to_play: Launch Do Not Stop on Roblox and stay in the lobby — codes are redeemed there, not during a run.
Select the CODES option inside the garage.
Type a code exactly as shown. They're all uppercase, so RELEASE, not release.
Confirm to claim the credits attached to that code.
Go back and repeat for each remaining code — you can enter all six listed on the game page.
Once you're in a run, keep the vehicle moving: the description warns that if you stop driving, it will catch you.
tips: Redeem codes before your first run so you're starting with credits instead of earning them from scratch.
All six listed codes together come to 1,350 credits (250 + 250 + 200 + 150 + 250 + 250).
Codes live in the game's own description, so if one stops working, check the Roblox page first — that's where updates show up.
Watch a full playthrough video before you play if you want to know how the levels are laid out and how the ending arrives.
Runs involve driver and passenger roles, so bring someone you can talk to rather than joining solo.

faq.q: What are the Do Not Stop codes?
faq.a: The Roblox game description currently lists six: RELEASE (250 credits), LASTSTOP (250 credits), DONOTSTOP (200 credits), ROUTE1610 (150 credits), TOURNAMENT (250 credits) and UPDATE2 (250 credits).

faq.q: Where do I redeem codes in Do Not Stop?
faq.a: In the lobby, open GARAGE and then choose CODES. That's the path the game itself gives in its description.

faq.q: How many credits do the codes give in total?
faq.a: Adding up the six listed values gives 1,350 credits.
The game page doesn't say. Nothing in the description gives expiry dates, so treat that as unknown rather than confirmed.
The description lists the credit amounts but doesn't explain what they're spent on. Check the in-game garage once you've redeemed them.
No price is listed on the Roblox page. It runs on Roblox, which you can install on PC, Mac, mobile, tablet, Xbox, PlayStation or VR.

faq.q: How many people can play at once?
faq.a: Servers are listed as supporting up to 20 players.

faq.q: What kind of game is it?
faq.a: A driving horror experience inspired by analog horror creatures and stories, where the core rule is to never stop the car.
